title: File Upload
content: Create drag-and-drop file upload component. Drop zone: dashed border area, highlight on drag over. Content: Upload icon, "Drag files here or click to browse" text. Click handler: opens file input dialog. Validation: file type and max size validation. File list: show selected files with name, size, remove button. Preview: image thumbnails. Upload progress: progress bar per file with percentage.

variants.simple: Create drag-and-drop zone for uploading files with progress indicator.
variants.detailed: Create drag-and-drop file upload component. Drop zone: dashed border area, highlight on drag over. Content: Upload icon, "Drag files here or click to browse" text. Click handler: opens file input dialog. Validation: file type and max size validation. File list: show selected files with name, size, remove button. Preview: image thumbnails. Upload progress: progress bar per file with percentage.
variants.advanced: Create drag-and-drop file upload component with comprehensive features. Drop zone: dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300) rounded-lg p-8, expand and highlight on drag enter (border-blue-500 bg-blue-50), revert on drag leave. Use onDragEnter, onDragOver (preventDefault), onDragLeave, onDrop events. Content: Upload/CloudUpload icon (w-12 h-12 text-gray-400), "Drag files here or click to browse" text, supported formats list (e.g., "PNG, JPG, PDF up to 10MB"). Click handler: onClick triggers hidden file input click. Input: hidden <input type="file">, accept attribute for file types (image/*,.pdf,.doc), multiple attribute for multi-file. Validation: check file.type against allowed types, check file.size against maxSize (show error toast for violations: "File too large" or "File type not allowed"). File list: show selected files in list below with file.name, formatted file.size (KB/MB), type icon (Image, FileText, File from lucide), remove button (X icon). Preview: generate image thumbnails using URL.createObjectURL for images, show file type icon for documents. Upload progress: progress bar per file (h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full with bg-blue-600 fill), percentage text, cancel button (X) to abort upload using AbortController. States per file: pending, uploading (show progress), completed (green CheckCircle), failed (red XCircle with "Retry" button). Handle multiple files dropped at once. Support drag and drop from desktop file manager. Accessibility: keyboard accessible (focus styles, Enter/Space to trigger), proper labels and aria-describedby. Handle errors: network failure, server rejection. Show total upload progress for multiple files. Consider chunked uploads for large files.
